clue.text: Humourless youngster to appear suddenly

blocks.note: short for po-faced, solemn and without humour
a young animal, or a cheeky young person

explanation.surface: A dour child suddenly turns up.
explanation.walkthrough: PO, from po-faced, is a recognised adjective for humourless; PO + PUP gives POP UP.
explanation.definitionFit: To pop up is an idiom for showing up abruptly and without warning.

clue.text: They pulverise some insects maybe (left half crushed)

indicators.note: half of a word keeps only part of its letters
something crushed is squeezed in between other things

blocks.note: some insects are pests
taken as written; its first half is kept

explanation.surface: Tools that crush bugs, perhaps, with the left side flattened.
explanation.walkthrough: LE, the first half of LEFT, is squeezed into PESTS.
explanation.definitionFit: Pestles are the club-shaped tools used with a mortar to grind substances to powder.

clue.text: Leaves maps — area for lake

indicators.note: one thing given for another means it replaces it

blocks.note: plans are maps or diagrams
A is the abbreviation for area
L is the abbreviation for lake; it is swapped out

explanation.surface: Someone abandons the maps, swapping an area for a lake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leaves' looks like a verb; it is the plural noun. A replaces L in PLANS.
explanation.definitionFit: Paan is betel leaf, folded with areca nut and chewed across South Asia.

clue.text: Bone — a foreign article that gets left embedded

indicators.note: embedded means set firmly inside something

blocks.note: una is 'a' in Italian or Spanish
L is the abbreviation for left

explanation.surface: A bone with a foreign object lodged in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Article' suggests an object stuck in the bone; it is the grammatical article.
explanation.definitionFit: The ulna is one of the two long bones of the forearm.

clue.text: State of grandmother nursed by Margaret

indicators.note: one nursed by another is held in their arms

blocks.note: Peg is a pet form of Margaret
nan is an informal word for grandmother

explanation.surface: Grandma's condition while Margaret is caring for her.
explanation.walkthrough: 'State' looks like condition; it is a Malaysian state.
explanation.definitionFit: Penang is one of the states of Malaysia, on the west coast of the peninsula.

clue.text: Plants money, going to casino recklessly

indicators.note: acting recklessly means acting wildly, so the letters of the gambling word are thrown about

blocks.note: M is the economists' abbreviation for money supply
taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone sinks money into factories, then blows it all at a gambling house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plants' looks like the verb invests; it is the noun, the cassava crops.
explanation.definitionFit: Manioc is another name for cassava, a starchy tropical shrub grown for its edible roots.

clue.text: Evil spirit ruffled hair on fellow

indicators.note: ruffled hair is messed up, so these letters are disordered

blocks.note: taken as written, then rearranged
a fellow is a man

explanation.surface: A demon messes up a man's hair.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' puts the first piece above the second.
explanation.definitionFit: Ahriman is the destructive spirit of Zoroastrianism, opponent of the good god Ahura Mazda.

clue.text: Presumed source of water, endless on island, for African animal

indicators.note: without an end means the final letter is dropped

blocks.note: Indra, the Hindu god of rain and storms, is held to send the rain
IS is the abbreviation for island

explanation.surface: Mythical water source on an island suits an African creature.
explanation.walkthrough: Indra is the Vedic god of rain, hence the presumed source of water. Madagascar, home of this lemur, counts as African.
explanation.definitionFit: The indris (or indri) is the largest living lemur, native to Madagascar off the African coast.

clue.text: I love cold kale, oddly? It's food fit for cattle!

indicators.note: arranged oddly means put together in an unusual order

blocks.note: taken as written
love is zero, O, in tennis
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone confesses a strange fondness for chilled greens, the sort of thing cows eat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Oddly' suggests taking odd letters; here it signals a rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Oilcake is compressed seed residue left after oil extraction, used as livestock feed.

clue.text: Homes for felines you put in containers

indicators.note: put in means placed inside something else

blocks.note: cases are containers
thou is the old form of you

explanation.surface: Cat shelters where you place boxes.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is playful: the word is slang for brothels, read literally.
explanation.definitionFit: A cathouse is slang for a brothel, read literally as a house for cats.

clue.text: Delays ship needing to cross river

indicators.note: to cross a river is to span it, so one piece straddles the other

blocks.note: SS is steamship
the Tay is a Scottish river

explanation.surface: A ship is held up because it must get across a river.
explanation.definitionFit: Stays as a verb means postpones or halts, as in staying an execution.

clue.text: University in Egypt's province

indicators.note: one thing sitting in another means it is placed inside it

blocks.note: ET is the international vehicle registration code for Egypt
the Ivy League university in Connecticut

explanation.surface: A university located in an Egyptian region.
explanation.walkthrough: 'University' tempts one to write U; here it is a named American university.
explanation.definitionFit: An eyalet was an administrative division of the Ottoman Empire, Egypt among them.

clue.text: One entertains adult church member

indicators.note: to entertain is to receive a guest, holding them within

blocks.note: a unit is a single thing, one
A is the old film certificate for adult

explanation.surface: Someone hosts a grown-up who belongs to a congregation.
explanation.definitionFit: A Uniat is a member of an Eastern church that accepts papal authority while keeping its own rites.

clue.text: Girl between street and a railway in mining area

indicators.note: placed between means set after the first item and before the next ones

blocks.note: standard abbreviation for street
a girl's name
taken as written
abbreviation for railway

explanation.surface: A girl stands between the road and the tracks in a mining district.
explanation.walkthrough: ST + ANN + A + RY.
explanation.definitionFit: The stannaries were the tin-mining districts of Cornwall and Devon, with their own courts.

clue.text: Insatiable person in pub, a drone

blocks.note: a bar is a pub
taken as written
a thrum is a monotonous humming sound

explanation.surface: A greedy bore holding forth in the pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drone' looks like a dull person; it is the humming sound.
explanation.definitionFit: Barathrum, Latin for an abyss, is applied figuratively to a glutton, someone who can never be filled.

clue.text: Form of government, cunning, invested in form of self-help

indicators.note: money invested in something is put inside it, so one piece goes within another

blocks.note: do-it-yourself is the home-improvement form of helping yourself
arch as an adjective means sly or roguish

explanation.surface: A political system said to be crafty and wrapped up in self-improvement.
explanation.walkthrough: DIY stands for do-it-yourself, the British term for home repairs done without a tradesman.
explanation.definitionFit: A diarchy is rule shared by two powers or persons, a system of government.

clue.text: Using an electronic device, the French celebrate

blocks.note: la is the French feminine for the
to sing someone's praises is to celebrate them

explanation.surface: French people celebrate with a gadget.
explanation.walkthrough: LA + SING.
explanation.definitionFit: Lasing is the action of a laser emitting coherent light, so a laser device is in use.

clue.text: Monetary amounts majorities somehow got without exceptional merit

indicators.note: without means lacking, so some letters are taken away
exceptional suggests out of the ordinary, so the merit letters leave from scattered places
somehow means in some unspecified way, so what remains is put in a new order

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written; these letters are removed

explanation.surface: Large majorities were won undeservedly, and money changed hands.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove M, E, R, I, T from MAJORITIES, leaving AJOIS, then rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: The jiao is a Chinese currency unit worth a tenth of a yuan, so jiaos are sums of money.

clue.text: One records muscular work — therefore little good having striker

blocks.note: Latin for therefore
G is the abbreviation for good
a ram strikes with its head, as does a battering ram

explanation.surface: A sour verdict on a footballer's labours: therefore not much good having this striker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Striker' sounds like a footballer; it is a butting RAM.
explanation.definitionFit: An ergogram is the tracing produced by an ergograph, a device measuring muscular effort.

clue.text: Rootstock found in country mostly — get wildly enthusiastic about it

indicators.note: mostly means not quite all, so the last letter goes
something found in another is located inside it
going about something means surrounding it

blocks.note: gaga means infatuated, crazy about
a land is a country

explanation.surface: A root discovered in a nation, and people going wild over it.
explanation.definitionFit: Galanga is a ginger-like plant whose aromatic rhizome is used in South-East Asian cooking.

clue.text: Once more find out about king and knight

blocks.note: re means concerning
Shakespeare's King Lear
N is knight in chess notation

explanation.surface: Discovering again the facts about a king and a knight.
explanation.walkthrough: RE + LEAR + N.
explanation.definitionFit: To relearn is to discover or master again what was once known.

clue.text: Held up after change of direction — put out, as before

indicators.note: a change of direction swaps one hand side for the other

blocks.note: held up means delayed

explanation.surface: Delayed by a detour and annoyed, as previously.
explanation.walkthrough: Left becomes right: L in DELAYED becomes R. 'As before' marks an archaic word.
explanation.definitionFit: Deray is an obsolete verb meaning to disorder or disturb, so derayed meant upset.

clue.text: Old woman hugs quivering pet, offering home support?

indicators.note: something quivering is shaking, so the letters are shaken up
to hug is to wrap one's arms around

blocks.note: a hag is an ugly old woman
taken as written, then rearranged

explanation.surface: An old lady cuddles her trembling pet, a comfort at home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Support' suggests emotional comfort; it is a fixture for hanging a hat.
explanation.definitionFit: A hat peg is a wall fitting that holds hats in a house, a domestic support.

clue.text: African insect — numbers will be eaten

indicators.note: something eaten ends up inside the eater

blocks.note: a common insect
nines are numbers

explanation.surface: An African insect devours numbers of something.
explanation.definitionFit: Beninese describes a person from Benin in West Africa, so an African.

clue.text: Annoying one Queen and her partner?

blocks.note: Roman numeral one
R for regina, queen
a queen's husband is a king

explanation.surface: A queen and her consort being irritating.
explanation.walkthrough: I + R + KING.
explanation.definitionFit: Irking means irritating or vexing someone.

clue.text: Book eventually shortened

indicators.note: made shorter means a letter is lopped off the end

blocks.note: at last means eventually

explanation.surface: A book is finally abridged.
explanation.walkthrough: AT LAST loses its final T.
explanation.definitionFit: An atlas is a bound volume of maps, a kind of book.

clue.text: Very foolish person, sloth

blocks.note: an ass is a fool
the ai is the three-toed sloth

explanation.surface: A really silly, lazy person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Very' looks like an intensifier for 'foolish'; it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Assai is a musical direction from Italian meaning very, as in allegro assai.

clue.text: Bullet in drawer

blocks.note: first meaning: a round that leaves a visible trail
second meaning: one who copies a drawing by following its lines

explanation.surface: A bullet lodged in a piece of furniture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drawer' suggests the sliding box in a chest; it is a person who draws.
explanation.definitionFit: A tracer round burns to show its path, and a tracer is also someone who traces drawings.

clue.text: Number firm put on record

blocks.note: CO is company
a log is a record

explanation.surface: A company's figure entered in the books.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue, 'put on' places the first piece above the second.
explanation.definitionFit: A cologarithm is the logarithm of a reciprocal, a mathematical number.

clue.text: Society tea host appearing in break

blocks.note: S is the abbreviation for society
the Mad Hatter hosts the tea party in Alice in Wonderland

explanation.surface: A society hostess pours tea during an interval.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Break' suggests a tea break; it is the verb to smash.
explanation.definitionFit: To shatter is to break suddenly into many pieces.

clue.text: Despicable person atop a tree

indicators.note: in a down entry, on top of means placed before the next item

blocks.note: a rat is a contemptible person
taken as written

explanation.surface: A scoundrel perched up a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: RAT + A.
explanation.definitionFit: The rata is a New Zealand tree of the myrtle family with red flowers and hard timber.

clue.text: Workplace colleague, one bound to be in "lippy" mode

indicators.note: something bound to be somewhere is fixed inside the rest

blocks.note: a laboratory, a scientist's workplace
an ally is a partner or associate
Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A colleague at work is always cheeky.
explanation.walkthrough: "Lippy" means cheeky in the surface, but is read literally here: done with the lips.
explanation.definitionFit: Labial means relating to the lips, so labially describes speech made with the lips.

clue.text: Hesitation at end of month to provide something boring

indicators.note: placed at the end of something means it follows on after it

blocks.note: abbreviation for August
the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: Someone dithers at month's end over something dull.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boring' suggests dull; it means drilling.
explanation.definitionFit: An auger is a tool for drilling holes, a thing that bores.

clue.text: The first person, with holy books, one to sing in church?

blocks.note: I is the first-person pronoun
New Testament
taken as written

explanation.surface: A believer with scriptures, the one to chant in church.
explanation.walkthrough: I + NT + ONE.
explanation.definitionFit: To intone is to chant a liturgy on a single note, as a priest or choir does.

clue.text: Picture wise men — in the East travelling round

indicators.note: going round something means surrounding it

blocks.note: IN taken as written, then E for East
the three Magi of the Nativity

explanation.surface: An image of the Magi journeying in the Orient.
explanation.definitionFit: To picture something is to form it in the mind, to imagine it.

clue.text: Bound to be good, getting on

blocks.note: G is the abbreviation for good
getting on means growing old

explanation.surface: Destined to behave while growing older.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bound' looks like 'certain'; it means pledged.
explanation.definitionFit: Gaged is an archaic past participle of gage, meaning pledged or committed by a pledge.
